payout_quote: By making a valid referral, Referrer will receive $100 and Friend will receive $50. Referrer can earn a maximum of 5 rewards per calendar year (maximum of $500).
steps: Be a WECU member in good standing and refer a friend
Friend applies for and qualifies for WECU membership and opens a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking account
Within 60 days of opening, friend makes ten (10) debit card purchases of at least $5 each
You receive $100 deposited into your longest-active WECU checking (or savings if no checking) on day 63; friend receives $50 in their checking
catches: Cap: 5 referral rewards per calendar year ($500 maximum)
Friend must be new to WECU membership and open Spend Plus or Spend Free checking
Friend must make 10 debit purchases of $5+ each within 60 days
Rewards paid on day 63 (scheduled); both parties must be in good standing
Referrer and Friend responsible for all federal, state and local taxes
WECU may cancel or suspend the promotion at any time
biggest_catch: $100 per referral is strong — but your friend must actually use the debit card: 10 purchases of $5+ within 60 days, or no one gets paid.
eligibility: WECU members in good standing; referred friends must be new WECU members opening eligible checking
timing: Friend qualifies within 60 days of account opening; rewards paid on day 63
